title: Araylim · Future & Modals — Homework
headline: A Trip to the Mountains
intro: Read the email and answer the questions. Practice future forms and modal verbs!

paragraphs.label: A.
paragraphs.text: Hi Araylim! I have great news. My family and I are going to visit the mountains next month. We are leaving on Friday afternoon. We have already booked a small cabin near a lake. You should come with us! It is a wonderful opportunity to relax.

paragraphs.label: B.
paragraphs.text: There are a few things you must know. You have to bring warm clothes because it will be cold at night. You don't have to bring food, because we will buy it there. Also, you must not forget your hiking boots. We will be walking a lot.

paragraphs.label: C.
paragraphs.text: By the time we return, we will have climbed the highest mountain in the area. I hope you can join us. Let me know if you can come by tomorrow. I will book the extra bed as soon as I hear from you.
